_comment: eleven = ElevenLabs voice (D-040, scripts/gen_voice_eleven.py); speakers without it keep their Kokoro clips. Voice cast (docs/ANIMATION_AUDIO.md > Character voices). speaker id -> Kokoro base voice or blend ('a:0.6+b:0.4') + post-processing in scripts/voice_cast.py. Shared by scripts/gen_voice.py and src/audio/cast.ts. speed = Kokoro speaking rate; pitchSemitones = total pitch shift; formantSemitones = the part of it that also moves formants (smaller vocal tract = younger); tempo = final tempo after processing. Every voice is original synthetic speech and imitates no real performer or existing character. 'provisional' = character still in design; voice may change.
testSentence: Hi there! I'm so happy you're here. Shall we play a game together?

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.description: The BrainZippy guide voice chosen by the owner (2026-11-17). Unprocessed; every existing clip uses it.

bobbo.name: Bobbo
bobbo.description: Little boy, warm and eager, a touch breathless; quick bursts of words.

zuzu.name: Zuzu
zuzu.description: Girl with a dramatic, sing-song British lilt; the widest pitch swoops in the cast.

gloop.name: Gloop
gloop.description: The smallest, highest voice: curious and giggly, questions that bounce up at the end.

hoot.name: Hoot
hoot.description: Older boy storyteller with a British lilt; warm, a bit theatrical, very clear words.

rumble.name: Rumble
rumble.description: Big gentle kid: slow, sleepy, soft and round; the lowest voice in the cast.

puff.name: Puff
puff.description: Airy, sparkly girl; floaty and light, smiling through every word.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: Crisp, bouncy kid with a neutral voice; short sentences in step order; never robotic.

zephy.name: Zephy
zephy.description: Calm, confident older girl with a British accent; steady like a kind flight instructor.

budge.name: Budge
budge.description: Friendly, clear, unhurried girl; says amounts slowly.

fenn.name: Fenn
fenn.description: Quick, curious, reassuring boy; drops a little quieter for 'look closer', never spooky.

dabble.name: Dabble
dabble.description: Enthusiastic, clear girl; asks a question before she gives an answer.

yonder.name: Yonder
yonder.description: Friendly, wondering boy; slow and careful with every place name.

snug.name: Snug
snug.description: Soft, warm, slow girl with pauses; never sing-song about feelings.

brix.name: Brix
brix.description: Hearty, practical older boy with a British accent.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.description: Calm, bright girl with a British accent; notices tiny things.

ziggy.name: Ziggy
ziggy.description: PROVISIONAL (pilot path; character in design): upbeat, adventurous older-kid co-pilot; steady and sure.

sarah.name: Sarah
sarah.description: PROVISIONAL (English path; character in design): warm, expressive girl who loves words.
